name: Deploy to cPanel (FTP)

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: deploy
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      FTP_HOST: ${{ secrets.FTP_HOST }}
      FTP_USER: ${{ secrets.FTP_USER }}
      FTP_PASS: ${{ secrets.FTP_PASS }}
    steps:
      - name: Get the code (full history, so we can see what changed)
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Install lftp (FTP client that reconnects and retries)
        run: sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo apt-get install -y -qq lftp

      - name: Upload to the server
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          # FTPS, and keep reconnecting if the server drops the line
          SETTINGS="set ftp:ssl-force true; set ftp:ssl-protect-data true; set ssl:verify-certificate no; \
                    set net:timeout 60; set net:max-retries 20; set net:reconnect-interval-base 5; \
                    set net:reconnect-interval-max 30; set ftp:passive-mode true"
          ftp() { lftp -u "$FTP_USER","$FTP_PASS" -e "$SETTINGS; $1; bye" "$FTP_HOST"; }

          # Files the server never needs
          EXCLUDE='^(\.git|\.github/|node_modules/|vendor/|storage/|bootstrap/cache/|tests/|resources/js/|resources/css/|\.env|package(-lock)?\.json$|vite\.config\.js$|tsconfig.*\.json$|phpunit\.xml$|\.deployed-sha$)|(^|/)\.gitignore$|\.(zip|sql|md)$'

          # Which commit is already on the server?
          LAST=$(ftp "cat .deployed-sha" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '[:space:]' || true)
          echo "Last deployed commit: ${LAST:-none}"

          if [ -n "$LAST" ] && git cat-file -e "$LAST^{commit}" 2>/dev/null; then
            # ── Normal run: only files changed since the last deploy ──
            git diff --name-only --diff-filter=ACMRT "$LAST" HEAD | grep -Ev "$EXCLUDE" > changed.txt || true
            git diff --name-only --diff-filter=D     "$LAST" HEAD | grep -Ev "$EXCLUDE" > deleted.txt || true
            echo "Changed: $(wc -l < changed.txt)   Deleted: $(wc -l < deleted.txt)"

            : > script.lftp
            while IFS= read -r f; do
              d=$(dirname "$f")
              [ "$d" != "." ] && echo "mkdir -p -f \"$d\"" >> script.lftp
              echo "put \"$f\" -o \"$f\"" >> script.lftp
            done < changed.txt
            while IFS= read -r f; do
              echo "rm -f \"$f\"" >> script.lftp
            done < deleted.txt

            if [ -s script.lftp ]; then
              cat script.lftp
              ftp "source script.lftp"
            else
              echo "Nothing to upload."
            fi
          else
            # ── First run: upload everything, skipping files already the same size ──
            echo "First deploy: mirroring the whole project (resumes if the line drops)"
            ftp "mirror -R --ignore-time --parallel=2 --verbose \
                  -X .git/ -X .github/ -X node_modules/ -X vendor/ -X storage/ -X bootstrap/cache/ \
                  -X tests/ -X resources/js/ -X resources/css/ \
                  -X .env -X '.env.*' -X '.gitignore' -X '*.zip' -X '*.sql' -X '*.md' \
                  -X package.json -X package-lock.json -X vite.config.js -X 'tsconfig*.json' -X phpunit.xml \
                  ./ ./"
          fi

          # Remember what's now on the server
          echo "$GITHUB_SHA" > .deployed-sha
          ftp "put .deployed-sha -o .deployed-sha"
          echo "Deployed $GITHUB_SHA"
